title: Why is restaurant music so loud? — Daniel Fox
meta_description: Operators turn the music up to turn tables faster. The one field experiment that measured restaurant volume found the tab ran about 16 percent higher when the volume came down.

schema.headline: Why is restaurant music so loud?
schema.description: What the field research says about restaurant volume, why the turn-tables-faster theory does not survive the one experiment that tested it, and where the studies still disagree.
